Levels.preview: The scene was previewed before the search display.
Levels.no_preview: A grey placeholder was shown instead of the preview.

face.Description: Whether the CNN predictor was computed with the face visible or occluded.

Levels.masked: Face region occluded by a grey mask (cnn_*_face_masked.npz).

r2.Description: Single-feature predictivity of the CNN predictor. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY).

sd_across_folds.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For r2.
